summary: Cut the seats domain (seat status, retirements, limits, subagents, rollouts, roster admission, harness questions, usage periods, accounts, runtime starts, stop deferral, external sessions, suspension and the sekrets daemon store) out of st3-store at function level into the new st3-seats crate; its Store methods are extension traits that st3-daemon re-exports, and every module keeps its old path.
